HEADING: Delete SSO User
MESSAGE_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to delete this SSO user? This can't be undone. If your SSO integration signs them in again, they will be re-created as a new user.
LABEL_COMMENTS: What should happen to their comments?
COMMENT_ACTION_KEEP: Keep their comments as they are
COMMENT_ACTION_ANONYMIZE: Anonymize their comments (keep the text, remove their name and email)
